# Antics

> Antics is a party game app for iPhone and Android: a whole stack of pass-the-phone party games and thousands of cards on one phone, with no ads and no accounts. It is a party-only edition built on forfeits rather than drinking, so drinkers and non-drinkers play the same game. The website offers free rules guides, free browser-based question generators, and how-to articles for each game.

## Key facts

- Name: Antics, listed on the stores as "Antics: Party Games & Dares" and often written "Antics Party Games". Website: anticsapp.com. Not connected to playantics.com or antics.gg.
- What it is: nine pass-the-phone party games on one phone: Antics mode, The Four Kings, Never Have I Ever, Truth or Dare, Most Likely To, Would You Rather, What Are The Odds, Imposter and Spicy. Thousands of cards, and the app remembers which cards a phone has shown so they do not repeat until every card has been seen.
- Platforms: iPhone and Android.
- Price: free to download. Imposter and The Four Kings are free to play in full; the other games include free cards, and Antics Premium unlocks the full decks and Spicy. Premium is a weekly subscription (the first week is free for new subscribers on iPhone), a monthly subscription, or a one-off Forever purchase. Prices are shown in the app.
- Age: rated 18+ on the App Store and made for adult groups.
- Drinking: never required. Every game runs on forfeits, so drinkers and non-drinkers play the same game.
- No ads, no accounts, no sign-up.
- Languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Italian, Dutch, Polish and Czech. Spicy cards are in English in every language.
- Made by: Guy, a solo founder in the UK, published by Antics App Ltd. Contact: support@anticsapp.com.

## Original data

- [Antics party data: how groups really play party games](https://anticsapp.com/party-data/): anonymous aggregates from parties played on Antics, 26 August to 4 October 2026: when parties start (UK time), the busiest night, how many games a party plays, truth versus dare and which cards get skipped. Percentages and ratios only. Free to use under CC BY 4.0 with a link; CSV at https://anticsapp.com/party-data/antics-party-data-2026-10.csv. Ready-made charts (PNG, landscape and portrait, source set into each image) at https://anticsapp.com/party-data/#charts. Press: support@anticsapp.com.

## Free browser generators

Each generator runs in the browser with no sign-up and no ads, and has two decks:
a Party deck and a Clean deck (forfeits only, no drinking, no innuendo, no
swearing) suitable for workplaces, weddings and family events.
Switch with the on-page toggle or by adding `?mode=clean` to the URL.
All five are free to embed as an iframe; add `?embed=1&mode=clean` for a
locked clean version.

- [Never Have I Ever generator](https://anticsapp.com/never-have-i-ever-generator/)
- [Would You Rather generator](https://anticsapp.com/would-you-rather-generator/)
- [Most Likely To generator](https://anticsapp.com/most-likely-to-generator/)
- [Truth or Dare generator](https://anticsapp.com/truth-or-dare-generator/)
- [What Are The Odds generator](https://anticsapp.com/what-are-the-odds-generator/)
